title: Add option to set shortcuts for Audio Input & Audio Output switching
line: You can now set keyboard shortcuts to switch to the next audio output or input device, with an on-screen notice naming the new device.
explanation: The Audio Volume shortcuts only covered volume, mute and push to talk, so changing the default output or input device always meant opening the audio applet or System Settings. The 2023 MR plasma-pa!161 added this to the old QML applet, but the shortcuts have since moved to the kded module, so it no longer applies. The change adds two global actions, "Switch to Next Output Device" and "Switch to Next Input Device", that cycle through the devices the applet lists by default (skipping virtual, dummy and unplugged ones) and show an OSD with the new device's name.

commits.message:
kded: add shortcuts to switch to the next output and input device

There was no way to change the default audio device from the keyboard,
so switching between speakers and a headset meant opening the applet.
Add two global actions that cycle through the devices and show an OSD.

BUG: 515142

media.caption: Shortcuts > Audio Volume on master: no action to switch devices
Two new actions: Switch to Next Input Device and Switch to Next Output Device
Pressing the output shortcut (Meta+Ctrl+O here) twice: Speakers → Headphones → Speakers, with an OSD
Pressing the input shortcut (Meta+Ctrl+I here) twice: Built-in → Headset Microphone and back
